properties.summary: Accepted the merge integrator's resolutions: both lanes' commands and lane 03's mirrorAll wrapper kept (41 commands / 25 full-surface / 16 default re-pinned); the `events` CLI word goes to lane 03's live-log reader on `twining` while `twining-mcp events` keeps lane 02c's database-free rollback reader and reports STORE_ROLLED_BACK naming the other; admission honours a prior admitted verdict in the replica's own admission log so a later policy cannot re-answer the bootstrap question (monotonic in time); adapters cite the current policy event (EventStore.currentPolicyEvent) so mirrored writes are never quarantined no_policy_yet on a store that ran the ceremony.
